statements.t: Despite elevated fuel prices and geopolitical uncertainty, Adjusted Diluted EPS grew 30% and Adjusted EBITDA grew 15.0% year-over-year, with record 24% Adjusted EBITDA growth in Engine Services supporting another increase to our full-year 2026 guidance,” said Paul McElhinney, StandardAero’s Chief Executive Officer.

McElhinney continued, “With a healthy backlog, long-term visibility and continued progress in deleveraging, we intend to enter into a $350 million accelerated share repurchase and the Board has increased our share repurchase authorization to $1.0 billion.
These actions reflect our confidence in the long-term outlook for the company and commitment to disciplined capital allocation and long-term shareholder value creation.”

In connection with the increased authorization, the Company intends to enter into an accelerated share repurchase agreement (the “ASR”) with Morgan Stanley to repurchase $350.0 million of its common shares.

Although StandardAero has previously provided guidance for Free Cash Flow, the Company has determined to provide guidance for Adjusted Free Cash Flow going forward because management believes that excluding the purchase of all intangible assets will provide investors with a more useful baseline for evaluating the Company’s core operating performance, as these cash payments—whether arising from acquisition…

StandardAero has not reconciled its full year 2026 guidance related to Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Free Cash Flow or Adjusted Diluted EPS to its most directly comparable forward looking GAAP financial measure because such information is not available, and management cannot reliably predict all of the necessary components of such GAAP measure without unreasonable effort or expense.

They appear in a number of places throughout this press release and include statements regarding our intentions, beliefs or current expectations concerning, among other things, results of operations for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, our financial condition, liquidity, prospects, growth and strategies, the industry in which we operate, our share repurchase program, including the size and timing of…
